comment: Golden MCR hands used to cross-check the engine against an independent scorer (miaoda-game-mcr-mahjong-analysis-core). Notation follows the reference: suits m/p/s, honors E S W N (winds) and C F P (red, green, white dragons). `tiles` holds the 13 concealed tiles before the winning tile for a closed hand; declared melds, if any, are listed separately.

hands.note: Pure Straight; the reference counts One Voided Suit and Edge Wait here, not Two Terminal Chows.
Seven Pairs across three suits, no honors.

hands.tiles: 19m 19p 19s E S W N C F P
hands.note: Thirteen Orphans.
Four wind pungs plus a pair.
Three dragon pungs, one chow, one pair.
All Terminals: terminal pungs and a terminal pair.
Four concealed pungs won by self-draw.
All Pungs with all simples.
Full Flush, one suit only; pair is deliberately not the winning tile, so Last Tile is not implied.
Half Flush with a wind pair.
All Chows with all simples and a mixed double chow.
Pure Triple Chow: three identical chows in one suit.
Mixed Triple Chow: same rank in three suits.
Triple Pung: same rank in three suits.
All Fives: every set contains a 5.
Pure Shifted Pungs.
Upper Four, tiles 6-9 only.
Lower Four, tiles 1-4 only.
Outside Hand: every set has a terminal or honor.
All Simples with all chows.
Dragon pung plus a wind pung scoring both seat and round wind (round and seat are both East).
Last Tile Draw on the final wall tile.
Winning on the last tile of its kind, on top of the Pure Straight shape.
Self-draw on the Pure Straight shape with two flowers; flowers score outside the 8-point gate.
